text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: the ensemble treats the three farms as nearly one farm. Bars: mean correlation between pairs of the node's farms of the level (position within the farm's forecast band) that each ensemble member takes (blue) and that each observation takes (orange, blend arm). Higher means the farms move more together.'
text.tspan: Figure 2: the ensemble treats the three farms as nearly one farm. Bars: mean correlation between
pairs of the node's farms of the level (position within the farm's forecast band) that each ensemble
member takes (blue) and that each observation takes (orange, blend arm). Higher means the farms move
